reviews_source: Verbatim review text extracted from Booksy's own NUXT_DATA payload (business-reviews:605216), fetched 2026-07-19. Names as truncated/displayed by Booksy itself (first name + last-initial where Booksy shows it that way).
brand_vibe: Black-and-gold glam branding (logo: black background, gold glitter ring, serif 'MNM' monogram). Photography is almost entirely extreme macro close-ups of eyes/lashes/brows: warm skin tones, soft directional light, dramatic full lash fans (hybrid/volume sets), a few lighter/blue-eyed clients for lash lift results. No interior/storefront photos available. Overall feel: glam, bold, intimate, high-glamour beauty studio rather than a soft spa; a dark, gold-accented base (black/charcoal background with warm gold/champagne accent) suits the brand better than a pale cream base.

palette_suggestion.nota: Gold-on-black glam to match the logo's black + gold-glitter branding; warm skin-tone macro photography reads best against a dark, warm charcoal background.
